paragraphs.text: Arlo Wickel is a Prismari mage on Arcavios .
Arlo Wickel is a Prismari mage known for his impressive earth magic skills, which he demonstrated during a Mage Tower match.

He has a commanding presence and a quick-thinking nature, reacting swiftly to crises. When chaos erupted as the Oriq attacked, Arlo took charge, using his earth magic to protect younger students from the advancing creatures. He directed them to safety, showing leadership and courage in the face of danger. Amid the onslaught, Will Kenrith , still disoriented from a nap, encountered Arlo who urged him to follow the crowd to safety.
